legacy_archaeology.matcher_note: unit = one derived_columns line of the form <X>_NK: "'HUB_Y|' || rhs" in a health_dv_dbt .sql; bare-identifier rhs only, composites counted and skipped
legacy_archaeology.match_note: A recovered slot is keyed by the legacy raw-view stem (stg_health__<stem>); it is joined to the map's table_name by upper-casing the stem. Slots that match no map table are COUNTED, not dropped silently -- they are legacy views this consolidation does not carry.

hub_key_census.two_sources_note: Key slots come from TWO sources: resolved_key in the map (v2 and delta3 halves only -- the profile measures zero resolved_key on every legacy row) and the legacy half's forms recovered from health_dv_dbt's emitted SQL, read-only. Sweeping only the map reported 5 hubs as keyed nowhere and would have refused 8 satellites and 18 links on a false zero.
hub_key_census.non_hub_names_note: These are recorded in resolved_key.hub but are not hub codes in data_7.js. Counting them as hubs reported 18 of 20 hubs derivable from the map half alone.

exprs: md5(normalise(upper(nullif(trim( coalesce(ADD_LINE1,'') || '|' || coalesce(ADD_LINE2,'') || '|' || coalesce(ADD_LINE3,'') || '|' || coalesce(ADD_LINE4,'') || '|' || coalesce(CITY,'') || '|' || coalesce(STATE,'') || '|' || coalesce(STATE_CODE,'') || '|' || coalesce(PINCODE,'') ), '|||||||'))))
LNK(HUB_POLICY = nullif(trim(POLICY_NO),''), HUB_PARTY = nullif('EMP:' || coalesce(nullif(trim(POLICY_NO),''),'') || '#' || coalesce(nullif(trim(EMP_CODE),''),''), 'EMP:#'))

refused_tables.detail: this table shares no hub key with any other table in its own view, so it can only be reached by a cross join. REFUSED from the join; its columns are WITHHELD from the satellites that wanted them rather than multiplied into them.

every hub this table shares with its view carries MORE THAN ONE key slot on it (HUB_DOCUMENT:2, HUB_PARTY:3), so there is no single expression to join on. Joining on one slot would key the whole view by one role of a multi-role registry. REFUSED from the join; the slots are emitted as separate business-key columns so a modeller can rule on which is the join key.
